parsed.rationale: A 3-year-old with 2 days of fever to 102F who is well-hydrated, playful between fevers, and without rash has no red flags requiring urgent or in-person evaluation today. Routine asynchronous clinician review is appropriate to advise on antipyretic dosing, hydration, and criteria for escalation (e.g., fever beyond 5 days, poor fluid intake, decreased urine output, lethargy, rash, or difficulty breathing).
